products.name: Rise 4K
products.description: A broadcast PTZ camera for multicamera studios and live events, pairing a larger sensor with production synchronization and professional connections.
products.imageAlt: Rise 4K manufacturer product image

products.name: Move 4K
products.description: An automated Ultra HD pan-tilt-zoom camera for flexible production in classrooms, meeting spaces, worship and live venues. Select the lens range around the camera-to-subject distance.
features: NDI HX3 and baseband/IP output options
products.imageAlt: Move 4K manufacturer product image

products.name: Move SE
products.description: A Full HD PTZ camera for everyday live streaming and room capture, with presenter tracking and flexible connections in three optical zoom ranges.
features: HDMI, SDI, USB and IP connections
products.imageAlt: Move SE manufacturer product image

products.name: Link 4K
products.description: A motorized 4K camera designed for Dante AV-H environments, combining optical zoom, automated framing and networked AV integration.
products.imageAlt: Link 4K manufacturer product image

products.name: Studio 4K
products.description: A compact fixed-body camera with optical zoom for lecterns, studios and extra production angles, without a motorized pan-and-tilt head.
products.imageAlt: Studio 4K manufacturer product image

products.name: Studio SE
products.description: A Full HD fixed-body camera for planned capture positions or a complementary angle alongside PTZ cameras. Its discreet form suits teaching and meeting spaces.
products.imageAlt: Studio SE manufacturer product image

products.name: SimplTrack3
products.description: A dual-sensor camera that uses a wide reference view to follow presenters and frame groups. Tracking zones suit lectures, conferences and presentations.

products.name: Webcam 80
products.description: A compact USB webcam with a focused view for desk-based video and small production setups. Adjustable image controls help match the camera to its room.

products.name: SuperJoy
products.description: A tactile controller for productions needing IP and serial camera operation together. Groups, presets and configurable commands simplify repeat production actions.

products.name: PT Joy G4

products.name: HC Joy G4

products.name: Hive Studio
products.description: A shared workspace for remote camera control, production and collaboration. Review current Standard, Pro and Enterprise plans against camera compatibility and team size.

products.name: Horizon
